Helped tremendously by the moratorium, the sagging market had ceased sagging, and some stocks were even beginning to recover. This was true for practically every line save those lines in which Francis owned and which Regan was bearing. He continued bearing and making them reluctantly fall, and he noted with joy the huge blocks of Tampico Petroleum which were being dumped obviously by no other person than Francis.

“Now’s the time,” Regan informed his bear conspirators. “Play her coming and going. It’s a double ruff. Remember the list I gave you. Sell these, and sell short. For them there is no bottom. As for all the rest, buy and buy now, and deliver all that you sold. You can’t lose, you see, and by continuing to hammer the list you’ll make a double killing.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u031-r0003", "tag": "p", "text": "“How about yourself?” one of his bear crowd queried.", "sha256": "d311fd320ab4d5afadfe464b4718faff79b1f5928d0d8e4b524e44ca8be07145", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2649]", "source_html": "

“How about yourself?” one of his bear crowd queried.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u031-r0004", "tag": "p", "text": "“I’ve nothing to buy,” came the answer. “That will show you how square I have been in my tip, and how confident I am. His broker nodded.

“You’re finished?”

Again the nod.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u031-r0013", "tag": "p", "text": "“Which means that we’re busted, flat busted,” Francis went on to the exposition of his new idea. “Now it is perfectly clear, then, to your mind and mine, that a man can never be worse than a complete, perfect, hundred-percent., entire, total bust.”", "sha256": "f622c58aa51d128ffe3e6950b9597a3adb380ea23e0c55559baf8cbe9ce5fd60", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2659]", "source_html": "
